semantics.transitionSystem: Each feature is modeled as a partial transition F : I x S -> O x S'. requires defines the admissible input domain; ensures defines the post-state; invariants hold for every reachable transition; failures defines the conservative result outside the domain.
semantics.quantification: Unless a clause says bounded, variables are universally quantified over the stated admissible domain.
semantics.verificationMeaning: bounded-exhaustive and property evidence checks finite models; integration and regression evidence are executable refinement witnesses; static evidence checks types/build/configuration. Network and deployment contracts are not claimed as theorem-proved.

globalInvariants.statement: Every number used for price, quantity, exposure, probability, score, cost, or time arithmetic is finite and in its declared range before it can change money or persistent state.
Malformed, missing, stale, unauthenticated, or contradictory evidence cannot create or increase exposure, privilege, freshness, confidence, or deployment authority.
A decision at event time t depends only on evidence whose publication/event time is <= t; targets and later outcomes are excluded.
A reduce-only transition cannot increase absolute exposure, change its sign without passing through zero, or create exposure from flat.
Executed quantity, equity, fees, and cost buckets reconcile at every state transition within the declared floating-point tolerance.
Credentials, state, jobs, cache entries, bot workers, and operations are isolated by one unambiguous tenant identity.
Retryable create/update/import/publish operations have a stable identity and repeated application cannot duplicate their durable effect.
Secrets never appear in committed files, URLs, public runtime configuration, telemetry, exception text, or ordinary logs.
Queues, retries, buffers, requests, histories, process lifetimes, and search spaces have explicit non-negative finite bounds.
For fixed validated inputs, seed, configuration, and prior state, pure computation and serialized ordering are deterministic.
A deployment or branch promotion identifies an exact source revision and occurs only after the canonical checks for every changed surface pass.
Training, calibration, optimization, validation, and reported historical performance preserve chronological splits and embargoes and never fit preprocessing on future rows.

specifications.title: CLI, API routing, configuration, authorization, and runtime

requires.statement: A request is admissible iff its method/path exists, authentication and tenant evidence resolve, all parsed fields satisfy Args validation, and its body/time/resource limits hold.

ensures.statement: Accepted synchronous and asynchronous requests invoke the same validated domain operation; terminal async states are exactly succeeded, failed, timed-out, or cancelled and are pollable by their tenant-scoped identifier.

invariants.statement: Route documentation has unique method/path pairs; authorization cannot be weakened by CORS; retries do not create a second trading mutation; credential components trim ASCII boundary whitespace identically across runtimes, preserve the legacy namespace for separator-free values including Unicode credentials, and use domain-separated UTF-8 byte-length framing under platform:v2 only for separator-bearing tuples.

failures.statement: Parse, auth, tenant, timeout, or capacity failure returns an explicit non-success response and performs no trade or cross-tenant state transition.

evidence.contains: api endpoint docs have unique method/path pairs

specifications.title: Core domains, safe numbers, symbols, text, duration, normalization, and splits

requires.statement: Raw external scalars and identifiers are untrusted; smart constructors are the only constructors for refined numeric domains.

ensures.statement: NonNegative values are finite and >= 0, FinitePositive values are finite and > 0, normalized identifiers are canonical, and split partitions preserve input order without overlap.

invariants.statement: normalize(normalize(x)) = normalize(x); parse(render(x)) = x on canonical values; train ++ validation ++ test is an ordered partition of the admitted input.

failures.statement: Invalid numeric input maps to the documented conservative sentinel; invalid identifiers/durations return an explicit failure, never an invented venue or symbol.

specifications.title: Market-series integrity, context alignment, cache, and point-in-time universe

requires.statement: Bars have finite valid OHLCV, strictly increasing unique open times, positive interval, and a close-time computation representable in Int64.

ensures.statement: An admitted live series contains only closed, contiguous, ordered bars and every aligned peer value has the exact target open time.

invariants.statement: Cache age is not market age; freshness is computed from the last representable closed-bar time and cannot be made fresh by overflow or a future timestamp.

failures.statement: Gap, duplicate, open, stale, malformed, or overflowed time evidence yields a hold/error and cannot reach fresh-entry logic.

specifications.title: Exchange adapters, candles, signing, pagination, positions, and fills

requires.statement: Signed private requests require explicit credentials, canonical parameters, bounded clock skew, venue-valid symbol/filter/quantity, and a live-trading authorization witness.

ensures.statement: Decoded candles satisfy H-MARKET-DATA; order responses preserve sent/status/requested/executed evidence without promoting acceptance to a fill.

invariants.statement: Pagination ranges are ordered and non-overflowing; secrets are redacted; every fill applied to state is denominated and bounded by the requested intent.

failures.statement: Transport, decode, rate-limit, filter, signing, or ambiguous-fill failure cannot create a fill or fresh position.

specifications.title: External, exogenous, cross-sectional, and prediction-market evidence

requires.statement: An observation is admissible only when its value and publication time are finite/representable and publicationTime <= decisionTime.

ensures.statement: Each bar receives only the latest admissible observation at or before its close; cross-sectional membership is selected from the contemporaneous universe.

invariants.statement: Adding a future observation cannot change any earlier aligned feature or decision.

failures.statement: Missing/malformed optional evidence remains absent or neutral as documented and cannot synthesize confidence.

specifications.title: Predictor feature schema and ensemble evidence

requires.statement: A feature vector declares one stable ordered schema and is computed only from bars and attached observations available at its index.

ensures.statement: Feature dimension and ordering match the selected model; probability vectors are finite, non-negative, and normalized within tolerance.

invariants.statement: Prefix extension cannot alter an earlier feature row, and optional channels never shift the meaning of existing indices.

failures.statement: Dimension, finiteness, or probability-mass failure marks predictor evidence unavailable.

specifications.title: Tabular and probabilistic predictors

requires.statement: Training rows have one positive consistent feature dimension, finite inputs/targets, chronological availability, and valid algorithm hyperparameters.

ensures.statement: Prediction is finite or explicitly unavailable; quantile/conformal bounds are ordered and widening evidence cannot narrow their interval.

invariants.statement: Fixed data/config/seed is deterministic; malformed query/model evidence cannot emit a high-confidence usable prediction.

failures.statement: Malformed dimensions, values, bounds, or empty calibration fail to the model's documented unavailable/conservative result.

specifications.title: Sequence and transformer predictors

requires.statement: Window/patch lengths and weights are positive, shape-consistent, finite, and use only the prefix ending at the prediction index.

ensures.statement: Every admitted forecast is finite and corresponds to the declared next-step target and feature ordering.

invariants.statement: Appending future rows cannot change a previously emitted forecast for the same prefix.

failures.statement: Malformed model/window evidence returns unavailable rather than a partial or dimension-truncated forecast.

specifications.title: LSTM training, fine-tuning, multichannel shape, and persistence compatibility

requires.statement: Model parameter count exactly encodes a positive hidden size and input dimension; query channel count equals that dimension and all channels have one positive equal length.

ensures.statement: Training terminates within epochs/patience, preserves parameter shape, and valid prediction is finite; one-channel multi prediction equals univariate prediction.

invariants.statement: No query element is silently dropped because of dimension mismatch; unit outcome weights reproduce ordinary fine-tuning.

failures.statement: Malformed model parameters, channel count/length, or non-finite input fail closed to the documented neutral prediction.

specifications.title: Kalman filters, physics state, fusion, and online statistics

requires.statement: State covariance/variance and process/measurement noise are finite and non-negative; an update observation is finite and explicitly available.

ensures.statement: Posterior state and covariance remain finite, covariance non-negative, and valid evidence cannot increase uncertainty under the declared scalar update model.

invariants.statement: Malformed observations leave the prior unchanged; OnlineStats count/mean/M2 remain finite and M2 >= 0.

failures.statement: Invalid measurements are ignored and invalid configuration is rejected before filtering.

specifications.title: Technical indicators, strategies, and method selection

requires.statement: Indicator windows are positive and every bar used is in the prefix at the decision index.

ensures.statement: Indicators satisfy their mathematical bounds and strategy signals are normalized to long, short, or absent with their risk frame.

invariants.statement: Indicator/strategy prefix invariance and long-short side symmetry hold where the formula is symmetric.

failures.statement: Insufficient/malformed windows produce absent evidence and cannot open through the method gate.

specifications.title: Signal admission, directionality, volatility-confidence, and post-direction gates

requires.statement: A fresh entry requires one explicit finite edge, a finite non-negative threshold/cost, valid sizing evidence, and every enabled gate to admit the same normalized evidence.

ensures.statement: Entry is admitted exactly by the conjunction of enabled gates; blocked/exit-only behavior may preserve or reduce existing exposure but cannot open or flip it.

invariants.statement: Admissibility is non-increasing as fees, required edge, or strictness rise and non-decreasing as valid supporting edge/confidence rises within the declared domain.

failures.statement: Missing/non-finite/out-of-range evidence fails closed with a stable observable rejection reason.

specifications.title: Market, neural, capital-preservation, live-gap, and cost governors

requires.statement: Governor inputs/configuration are finite, range-valid, causally observed, and hard deterministic gates are evaluated before learned preference.

ensures.statement: Each governor returns a bounded multiplier/action; composing a more restrictive governor cannot increase fresh exposure.

invariants.statement: Hard safety blocks dominate learned policy; disabled/warmup/observe/shadow policy is behaviorally neutral for live orders; enforce requires promotion evidence and rollback permanently removes enforcement for that state.

failures.statement: Malformed/stale risk evidence yields hold or exit-only, never an entry multiplier.

specifications.title: Backtest and live decision state machine

requires.statement: Input vectors align, prices/OHLC are finite and valid, configuration is validated, and each event has one prior position/equity state.

ensures.statement: Each bar produces one deterministic next state; exposure is bounded; exits/partial exits reconcile trades and costs; emitted curves align by index.

invariants.statement: gross - cumulative realized costs = net within tolerance; no same-event re-entry occurs unless explicitly specified; live and backtest share entry/exit admission predicates.

failures.statement: Misaligned/malformed simulation evidence returns Left/flat and cannot emit NaN equity or exposure.

specifications.title: Live order intent and fill reconciliation

requires.statement: A fill transition requires sent/live/status evidence plus a positive finite executed or defensible fallback quantity in one declared unit.

ensures.statement: closeQty + openQty = sanitized executedQty; applied exposure fraction <= intended fraction; reduce-only never increases or flips exposure.

invariants.statement: Canceled/failed status with no executed quantity applies nothing; explicit partial fill evidence dominates terminal status text.

failures.statement: Unsent, ambiguous, non-positive, non-finite, or unitless live evidence applies no quantity.

specifications.title: Risk halts, leverage, drawdown, loss limits, and canonical risk register

requires.statement: All active limits and observed loss/drawdown/position/leverage metrics are finite and in their declared domain; reset events are explicit.

ensures.statement: The first reason in documented precedence is returned; daily/weekly halts reset only at their matching boundary and immediately re-halt on a current breach.

invariants.statement: For each valid configured limit, breach iff the corresponding halt is returned when no higher-priority reason exists; increasing loss cannot remove a halt; canonical risk IDs are unique and their ordered severity/status projections agree exactly across JSON, Haskell, and Markdown.

failures.statement: Malformed risk limit or metric returns a named invalid/non-finite halt; negative loss-streak limits cannot disable protection.

evidence.contains: canonical risk register has unique ordered IDs and coherent projections

specifications.title: Performance metrics, ROI score, and sensitivity analysis

requires.statement: Metric inputs and annualization horizon are finite/range-valid; sensitivity grid is finite, ordered, positive-sized, and has one baseline witness.

ensures.statement: Every emitted metric/score/elasticity is finite; sparse/no-trade evidence cannot outrank otherwise equal supported evidence through a numerical artifact.

invariants.statement: ROI score is monotone in the directions declared by its terms; sensitivity varies one parameter only and uses a finite closest/grid baseline without zero division.

failures.statement: Malformed/empty inputs yield explicit absent or conservative finite metrics, not NaN/Infinity.

specifications.title: Threshold tuning, search, walk-forward validation, overfit audit, and JSON records

requires.statement: Search budgets/ranges are finite and bounded, candidates validate, RNG seed is explicit, and chronological folds preserve embargo and held-out evaluation.

ensures.statement: Search terminates within budget and returns deterministically ordered valid candidates with objective, evidence, and overfit metadata.

invariants.statement: Validation/test evidence never influences training/preprocessing; tie-break is a total normalized order; retry/recovery cannot weaken safety gates.

failures.statement: No eligible candidate is an explicit result with filter reasons; malformed prior rows cannot enter the survivor set.

specifications.title: Top-combo scoring, merge, freshness, quarantine, tombstones, and bot adoption

requires.statement: A deployable combo has canonical identity, finite score/risk fields, sufficient trades, fresh timestamp, walk-forward evidence, and no active tombstone/quarantine.

ensures.statement: Merge deduplicates identity and preserves the newest admissible evidence; ranking is total; adoption caps exposure and preserves explicit disabled behavior.

invariants.statement: merge(x,x)=x after normalization; stale replicas cannot resurrect a tombstoned row; stricter evidence floors cannot add deployable combos.

failures.statement: Malformed, stale, low-evidence, losing, or quarantined combos remain visible only in their documented non-deployable tier and cannot auto-start trading.

specifications.title: S3, model persistence, database migrations, and state durability

requires.statement: Persistent writes have tenant-scoped keys, schema/version identity, authenticated destination, and complete serializable payload.

ensures.statement: A successful write is durably readable as the same logical value; migrations are ordered and idempotent; model shape survives round trip.

invariants.statement: Partial writes are not published as current state and retries cannot duplicate a migration or outbox identity.

failures.statement: Authentication, serialization, checksum, schema, or storage failure preserves the last valid state and reports an error without logging secrets.

specifications.title: Gate telemetry and threshold calibration

requires.statement: Telemetry bounds are non-negative; calibration samples and method/config parameters are finite and in range and are drawn from decision-time edge evidence only.

ensures.statement: Rejection totals equal histogram totals, recent length <= min(max(configured bound,0),1000), and unknown reasons occupy one canonical bucket; calibration output is finite, ordered, and uses the configured divisor/floor.

invariants.statement: Recording telemetry cannot affect a gate decision; percentile threshold is monotone; outcome returns are not calibration edge features.

failures.statement: Empty/malformed/overflowing distribution or method returns no calibration; telemetry bound <= 0 retains no recent events.

specifications.title: Executable reference models and close-timing analysis

requires.statement: A claimed equivalence uses an independent reference definition and a disclosed finite domain; a claimed implication checks the documented direction and non-vacuous witnesses.

ensures.statement: Every report Boolean and positive state-count field is forced by CI; any failed obligation fails the test process with its field name.

invariants.statement: Documentation names only existing executable witnesses and does not label bounded enumeration as an unbounded proof.

failures.statement: An unasserted, shared-implementation, vacuous, empty-domain, or stale obligation is verification failure, not evidence.

specifications.title: Executable entrypoints and outbox publisher

requires.statement: Each tracked entrypoint belongs to a Cabal component and validates all external configuration before starting side effects.

ensures.statement: Version/help/smoke paths terminate, JSON modes preserve schema, and outbox publication marks success only after the remote acknowledgement.

invariants.statement: The canonical build typechecks every tracked Haskell feature module and executable entrypoint.

failures.statement: Invalid config, database, or remote publish leaves work pending/failed with a non-zero exit or explicit state and no secret output.

specifications.title: Web canonical domains, form defaults, persistence, and request admissibility

requires.statement: Raw URL/storage/form values are untrusted and normalized against the same domain/cross-field constraints as the backend before a request can be enabled.

ensures.statement: normalize is idempotent, serialize/restore preserves platform-admitted values, lookback fitting is bounded, every fresh form starts with live orders and trade arming disabled, and admitted top-combo rows have deterministic unique identities with no future-dated freshness evidence.

invariants.statement: Frontend admissibility never enables a request the backend contract rejects; persisted secrets follow the selected storage authority and are not logged.

failures.statement: Malformed persisted or typed values revert to conservative non-live defaults and surface a field issue; primitive, default-only, or future-dated top-combo evidence is rejected before display or auto-apply.

specifications.title: Web API transport, deployment target, tenant, storage, and clipboard

requires.statement: Target URL/host, tenant key, request body, timeout, and expected response schema validate before transport; client-visible tokens are never classified as secrets.

ensures.statement: Requests use the resolved origin exactly, preserve query/path, attach only authorized tenant headers, and stop polling after terminal/cancel/timeout.

invariants.statement: Fallback cannot redirect to malformed authority; retries cannot duplicate trade intent; runtime bot decoding precedes UI state mutation, requires non-empty aligned core running series, and binds reported tenant identities plus unambiguous single-status symbols to request expectations.

failures.statement: Malformed target/response, timeout, abort, or storage error becomes an explicit UI error and cannot synthesize successful trading state.

evidence.contains: bot status decoder rejects malformed position evidence
tenant identity preserves unambiguous ASCII keys

specifications.title: Web trading, bot, position, account-history, state-sync, and stream state machines

requires.statement: Exposure-increasing actions require explicit current arming/confirmation, valid keys/tenant/form, healthy API, and no in-flight duplicate; close-position may bypass arming only as an explicit reduce-only exception.

ensures.statement: Latest-wins reads cannot be overwritten by stale responses; mutations have one in-flight identity; stop/close cannot auto-reopen; state-sync reports partial progress.

invariants.statement: Applying/importing a combo never auto-starts a live bot; stream teardown releases listeners; logs exclude secrets; a reduce-only close cannot increase position.

failures.statement: Stale, malformed, aborted, partial, or failed responses do not mutate authoritative success/running/exposure state.

specifications.title: Web optimizer, combos, charts, telemetry, performance, and navigation presentation

requires.statement: Displayed series have finite values or explicit gaps, declared units, stable identity, and aligned indices/timestamps.

ensures.statement: Downsampling preserves endpoints/order, ranking reflects backend tier/score, and UI labels distinguish gross/net/estimated/actual evidence.

invariants.statement: Rendering, sorting, filtering, or pagination cannot mutate trading state or misrepresent missing evidence as zero.

failures.statement: Malformed/non-finite rows are rejected or rendered as unavailable and never converted into a default deployable combo.

specifications.title: Web build, proxy, runtime configuration, and frontend container

requires.statement: Runtime origin is a validated HTTPS/HTTP authority and proxy Host/SNI are derived from that same authority; public config contains no server secret.

ensures.statement: Built assets start with one React runtime, proxy to the configured backend identity, and expose only documented client-visible settings.

invariants.statement: Changing TRADER_API_ORIGIN changes URL, Host, and TLS SNI coherently; production build is reproducible from the lockfile.

failures.statement: Invalid runtime origin/config fails container startup or disables fallback rather than proxying to a hidden hardcoded host.

specifications.title: Autoloop mutation, recovery, reconciliation, CI feedback, and process ownership

requires.statement: One verified process owns the workspace; mutation is limited to approved paths; recovery/checkpoint refs are prunable only after their commits are reachable from the promoted branch.

ensures.statement: Every promotion preserves recoverable failed work, runs all target checks implied by the diff, records the exact commit, and waits for required CI.

invariants.statement: An unmerged recovery/checkpoint ref is never deleted; non-Haskell changes cannot bypass web/automation/deployment checks; a failed cycle cannot push main.

failures.statement: Validation/check/CI/ownership failure retains recovery state, records a bounded error, and makes no promotion.

specifications.title: Research acquisition, point-in-time cache, walk-forward harness, and statistical analysis

requires.statement: Every observation has event/publication time, preprocessing is fit only on each training prefix, and cache overlap has an explicit field-level merge policy.
Pre-registered edge campaigns enumerate the complete trial grid, align all symbol/feature panels to an exact chronological bar grid, and seal the final holdout unless all promotion gates pass.

Historical funding campaigns bound every public acquisition window, preserve every endpoint-returned settlement event, causally resolve omitted marks, and hash raw plus aligned inputs before producing returns.
Risk-controlled campaigns lock exposure, equity, drawdown, turnover, deterministic shock, margin-reserve, liquidation-cost, and dependence-sensitivity rules before any campaign execution.

ensures.statement: Walk-forward results use disjoint chronological evaluation folds; cache mutation and cross-symbol snapshots use one shared lock plus atomic replacement; acquisition is wall-clock bounded; stale or degraded evidence cannot report pass or extend new point-in-time alignment past its freshness bound; seed/config/data revision are recorded.

Nested selection fits only embargoed training prefixes, evaluates the frozen selected candidate once on each untouched outer fold, and records complete trial-return matrices for formal DSR and CSCV/PBO diagnostics.

Perpetual returns attribute price, signed funding cashflow, turnover, and costs on exact close-to-close intervals; lifetime trial counts receive an explicit family-wise correction separate from current-campaign DSR/PBO.

Successful risk-controlled paths reconcile charged entry and terminal turnover with cost, while confidence promotion requires every registered circular block length rather than selecting the favorable dependence assumption.

invariants.statement: A future row cannot change earlier standardized features or signals; transaction costs are applied only after a causal decision.

Formal multiple-testing diagnostics operate on complete finite aligned return matrices; final-holdout openings are one-shot across overlapping symbol/time windows and completed entries reference atomically written evidence.
Each funding event is charged exactly once in (left close, right close], and a missing historical event mark can use only the containing hourly mark open rather than a future close.

A risk breach cannot be clipped, restarted, substituted, or continued as synthetic cash; strict holdout markers bind campaign, panel digest, canonical overlap window, registration, manifest, filename identity, and resolved output directory under the shared registry lock.

failures.statement: Missing publication metadata, incomplete overlap, or failed acquisition preserves prior cache and marks the experiment incomplete.
Sparse, incomplete, non-finite, misaligned, or ambiguous edge-campaign evidence fails closed before promotion or final-holdout consumption.
Historical page, grid, settlement, mark-resolution, schedule-gap, registration, or artifact-integrity failures produce no campaign result and consume no blocked final holdout.

Primary execution-risk breaches terminate with typed immutable evidence before registry reservation; a post-reservation holdout failure completes the one-shot registry without partial or synthetic returns.

specifications.title: Operational analysis, optimizer wrappers, scorecards, and risk gates

requires.statement: Input schema/version and decision-time feature population are explicit; realized outcomes are a separate labeled population and never mixed into entry-edge calibration.

ensures.statement: Reports are reproducible, finite, population-labeled, and risk/schema gates exit non-zero on violated invariants.

invariants.statement: No secret is printed and no outcome/post-trade field is interpreted as a causal entry feature.

failures.statement: Unknown schema, mixed population, insufficient evidence, or non-finite statistic fails the report/gate explicitly.

specifications.title: Monitoring, radio maintenance, restart helpers, and local process management

requires.statement: A managed PID is proven to belong to the expected command; probes/URLs are allowlisted against private/metadata targets; timeouts/retries are bounded.

ensures.statement: State/alerts persist atomically, one process instance is managed, and health means responsive plus non-halted/non-error within a bounded startup interval.

invariants.statement: PID reuse cannot kill an unrelated process; monitor/webhook/discovery failure cannot erase prior registry or hang indefinitely.

failures.statement: Identity/probe/persistence failure performs no destructive action and returns a non-zero/alertable state.

specifications.title: Canonical build, lint, test, formal coverage, and engineering review

requires.statement: The selected target is one of haskell, web, automation, smoke, or full and required pinned tools are available.

ensures.statement: Success means every commanded build/format/lint/smoke/test/formal-coverage step completed with exit 0; full is the conjunction of all target surfaces.

invariants.statement: Every covered production file maps to a unique-ID formal feature specification with non-empty clauses and live evidence links.

failures.statement: Missing tool, uncovered file, stale evidence marker, spec cycle, or failed check returns non-zero.

specifications.title: Fly, AWS, Render, and container deployment

requires.statement: Deployment identifies an already verified commit/image digest, validates required secret references without interpolating plaintext JSON, and declares rollback/health criteria.

ensures.statement: Running service reports the selected commit, exposes only intended ports/routes, uses injected secrets, and reaches health before promotion succeeds.

invariants.statement: Research and trading roles remain isolated; deployment tenant derivation matches backend canonical legacy and v2 vectors; temporary credential material is removed on every exit path; rerun converges idempotently.

failures.statement: Build, secret, migration, health, or promotion failure leaves the last healthy release active and emits no secret.

evidence.contains: AWS tenant derivation matches the canonical legacy and v2 vectors

specifications.title: Hetzner trading/research roles, Caddy, Postgres, webhook bridge, and remote deploy

requires.statement: Trading is live iff effective CLI and environment authorization are both explicitly true; research cannot route private order endpoints; remote tree projects one exact verified commit.

ensures.statement: Compose starts only declared available artifacts, role-specific credentials/routes, local durable Postgres, and health-checked services at the recorded commit.

invariants.statement: TRADER_BINANCE_LIVE=false or TRADER_BOT_TRADE=false implies no real order path; removed tracked files cannot remain active remotely; webhook target exists when configured.

failures.statement: Missing service artifact, contradictory safety toggle, role leak, sync drift, or failed health aborts promotion and leaves trading disabled.

specifications.title: Continuous integration, scheduled jobs, and deployment promotion

requires.statement: Workflow permissions are least privilege, secrets are injected by the platform, concurrency policy is explicit, and deployment consumes a successful verified commit.

ensures.statement: Required checks cover Haskell, web, automation/formal registry and deployment-specific validation before the exact commit is promoted.

invariants.statement: A failed/cancelled/skipped required check cannot be interpreted as green; manual dispatch cannot deploy an unverified branch tip.

failures.statement: Missing secret, failed check, stale commit, or concurrent superseding run prevents promotion.
